name: Welcome, Dear Human
source:
The dating simulator is alive and wants you...
...to date your sleep paralysis demon!

Learn to communicate with the monster and build a relationship built on trust.
Or don’t? It’s your story after all.

[From [url=https://ronkad.itch.io/welcome-dear-human]itch.io[/url]]
